She began to rip into me, demanding that I stay on the line until the issue was 100% resolved. Did the political thing and explained to her company policy, etc, but she still wouldn't have it. Finally she just really ripped into me. Normally I like to think I'm a calm and rational guy but I lost it. I told her that if she was too dense to understand that company policy has my hands tied in the manner that it was an issue I couldn't fix, and unfortunately I couldn't recommend a shrink due to another company policy she wouldn't understand. I forced her on hold and called dispatch (rather than fwd through the usual way) and gave them a heads' up. Took her off hold, explained I had to transfer her to dispatch and did so before she had a chance to respond. I knew it would be bad but no idea it would work out like it did.
